messages:
ana: FYI ran a restore smoke for tenant-88 and hit repeated decrypt failures near the end of the stream. blobs 5480-5502 failed with AccessDenied.
tom: error log: `AccessDeniedException: Decrypt denied for key arn:aws:kms:...:key/ef12` then `InvalidGrantTokenException` when retrying
siva: was there a recent RBAC tweak? i remember a change to restrict long-lived role permissions for restore-runner last week
ana: yes, PR 498 narrowed restore-runner to disallow kms:Decrypt directly; we rely on ephemeral grants now. link: https://git.redd/infrastructure/pulls/498
siva: check audit logs for CreateGrant and RevokeGrant around the restore window
ana-check: (typo) sorry ignore
tom: audit query: `fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.grantId | filter eventName in ["CreateGrant","RevokeGrant"] and userIdentity.arn like "%restore-runner%"`
siva: findings: CreateGrant issued at 14:05:00Z grantId=gr-77 ttl=300s. restore stream started 14:05:10Z but due to throttling final chunk hit 14:10:20Z -> grant expired
ana: long story: streaming restores open multiple workers and backpressure means duration > grant TTL. bad assumption.
eng-oncall: mitigation steps executed: 1) created a new grant with extended TTL 3600s 2) resumed restore 3) verification checksums matched
tom: follow-ups: 1) change: grant-service should expose remaining TTL in response; restore-runner should log grant expiry timestamp 2) set default TTL for restore role to 1800s or make it configurable per-job
siva: also add alerting: if restore job duration > 75% of grant_ttl, send warn to eng-security and backup-ops.
nana-again: (sorry) also ensure audit logging pipeline tags grants with job_id and snapshot_id for faster correlation
ana-fix: i meant ana: i'll open tickets for: grant-service TTL config, restore-runner grant-refresh flow, and audit tagging.
sec-bot: Incident drill recorded (id=drill-2026-07-09-01). Attach KMS audit logs and S3 manifests to ticket.
eng-oncall: leaving this thread open 48h for any late evidence. thanks all.
